title: When the Smile Wakes
author: Marguerite Delacroix
blurb: Odile Ashgrove, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
